title: Flood insurance is required on federally regulated loans in special flood hazard areas
rule: A federally regulated or federal agency lender may not make, increase, extend or renew a loan secured by improved real estate in a special flood hazard area where federal flood insurance is available unless the building and any personal property securing it carry flood insurance for the loan's term of at least the lesser of the principal balance and the program's maximum for that property type. Loans Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac buy must comply. Qualifying private policies count.
changeWatch: Amendments to 42 U.S.C. 4012a or to National Flood Insurance Program coverage limits, and FEMA map revisions that move a property into or out of a special flood hazard area.
